knowledge:
- key_parameters: axis=In nmr_interpolate_1D, defines the ppm range and resolution (e.g., axis = c(min = -0.5, max = 10, by = 2.3E-4)) ;; exclude=In nmr_exclude_region, a list of ppm ranges to fully remove (e.g., water, methanol) to prevent distortion of normalization ;; lambda=In nmr_baseline_removal or nmr_baseline_estimation, controls the smoothing parameter for Asymmetric Least Squares baseline subtraction ;; p=In nmr_baseline_removal or nmr_baseline_estimation, controls the asymmetry parameter for baseline subtraction ;; baselineThresh=In nmr_detect_peaks, the baseline threshold level used to discriminate peaks from noise, often calculated automatically using nmr_baseline_threshold ;; SNR.Th=In nmr_detect_peaks, the Signal-to-Noise ratio threshold used to dynamically estimate noise level per region ;; maxShift_ppm=In nmr_align, the maximum chemical shift allowed for peak alignment ;; method=In nmr_normalize, the normalization technique (e.g., "pqn" for Probabilistic Quotient Normalization) ;; fix_baseline=In nmr_integrate_regions, logical indicating whether to connect integration limits with a straight line to subtract as a local baseline
- alternatives: The package offers two main workflows: the modern peak clustering workflow (using nmr_baseline_estimation, nmr_peak_clustering, and nmr_build_peak_table) and the older peak integration workflow (using nmr_baseline_removal and nmr_integrate_peak_positions or nmr_integrate_regions).
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have raw 1D NMR spectra (such as plasma, serum, urine, or fecal extracts in Bruker or JDX format) and need to preprocess them into a clean, aligned, and normalized peak table or peak area matrix for downstream statistical analysis.
- pitfalls: PQN normalization (method = "pqn") is unreliable when the number of samples is small because it requires a robust estimation of the median spectrum ;; Regions to exclude (like water or methanol) must be fully removed using nmr_exclude_region rather than zeroed, as zeroing can distort PQN normalization results ;; Interactive plots (interactive = TRUE or plot_interactive) have performance limitations with many spectra/points and cannot be embedded directly in RMarkdown.

workflows.name: modern_peak_clustering
workflows.intent: Process raw 1D NMR spectra using the modern peak clustering workflow to generate a clean, aligned, and normalized peak table.
workflows.stages: 1. Load samples ;; 2. Add metadata ;; 3. Interpolate 1D spectra ;; 4. Exclude uninformative regions ;; 5. Robust PCA outlier detection ;; 6. Baseline estimation ;; 7. Baseline threshold calculation ;; 8. Initial peak detection ;; 9. Filter/accept peaks ;; 10. Find reference spectrum ;; 11. Align spectra ;; 12. Normalize spectra ;; 13. Recalculate baseline threshold and detect peaks on normalized spectra ;; 14. Peak clustering ;; 15. Build peak table ;; 16. Extract peak matrix
workflows.code:
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(BiocParallel)
library(AlpsNMR)

register(SnowParam(workers = 2, exportglobals = FALSE), default = TRUE)

MeOH_plasma_extraction_dir <- system.file("dataset-demo", package = "AlpsNMR")
MeOH_plasma_extraction_xlsx <- file.path(MeOH_plasma_extraction_dir, "dummy_metadata.xlsx")
annotations <- readxl::read_excel(MeOH_plasma_extraction_xlsx)

zip_files <- fs::dir_ls(MeOH_plasma_extraction_dir, glob = "*.zip")
dataset <- nmr_read_samples(sample_names = zip_files)

dataset <- nmr_meta_add(dataset, metadata = annotations, by = "NMRExperiment")

dataset <- nmr_interpolate_1D(dataset, axis = c(min = -0.5, max = 10))

regions_to_exclude <- list(water = c(4.6, 5), methanol = c(3.33, 3.39))
dataset <- nmr_exclude_region(dataset, exclude = regions_to_exclude)

pca_outliers_rob <- nmr_pca_outliers_robust(dataset, ncomp = 3)
nmr_pca_outliers_plot(dataset, pca_outliers_rob)

dataset <- nmr_baseline_estimation(dataset, lambda = 9, p = 0.01)

baselineThresh <- nmr_baseline_threshold(dataset, range_without_peaks = c(9.5, 10), method = "median3mad")

peak_list_initial <- nmr_detect_peaks(
    dataset,
    nDivRange_ppm = 0.1,
    scales = seq(1, 16, 2),
    baselineThresh = baselineThresh,
    SNR.Th = 3,
    fit_lorentzians = TRUE
)

peak_list_initial_accepted <- peaklist_accept_peaks(
    peak_list_initial,
    dataset,
    area_min = 50, 
    keep_rejected = FALSE,
    verbose = TRUE
)

NMRExp_ref <- nmr_align_find_ref(dataset, peak_list_initial_accepted)

dataset_align <- nmr_align(
    nmr_dataset = dataset, 
    peak_data = peak_list_initial_accepted, 
    NMRExp_ref = NMRExp_ref, 
    maxShift_ppm = 0.0015, 
    acceptLostPeak = TRUE
)

dataset_norm <- nmr_normalize(dataset_align, method = "pqn")

baselineThresh <- nmr_baseline_threshold(dataset_norm, range_without_peaks = c(9.5, 10), method = "median3mad")

peak_list_for_clustering_unfiltered <- nmr_detect_peaks(
    dataset_norm,
    nDivRange_ppm = 0.1,
    scales = seq(1, 16, 2),
    baselineThresh = baselineThresh,
    SNR.Th = 3,
    fit_lorentzians = TRUE,
    verbose = TRUE
)

peak_list_for_clustering <- peaklist_accept_peaks(
    peak_list_for_clustering_unfiltered,
    dataset_norm,
    area_min = 50, 
    keep_rejected = FALSE,
    verbose = TRUE
)

clustering <- nmr_peak_clustering(peak_list_for_clustering, verbose = TRUE)

peak_list_clustered <- clustering$peak_data

peak_table <- nmr_build_peak_table(peak_list_clustered, dataset_norm)
peak_matrix <- nmr_data(peak_table)

workflows.name: older_peak_integration
workflows.intent: Process raw 1D NMR spectra using the older API workflow to perform baseline removal, alignment, normalization, and direct peak integration.
workflows.stages: 1. Load samples ;; 2. Add metadata ;; 3. Interpolate 1D spectra ;; 4. Exclude uninformative regions ;; 5. Baseline removal ;; 6. Peak detection ;; 7. Find reference spectrum ;; 8. Align spectra ;; 9. Normalize spectra ;; 10. Integrate peak positions (by center/width or boundaries) ;; 11. Extract integrated data ;; 12. Identify regions

library(BiocParallel)
library(AlpsNMR)
library(ggplot2)

register(SnowParam(workers = 2, exportglobals = FALSE), default = TRUE)

MeOH_plasma_extraction_dir <- system.file("dataset-demo", package = "AlpsNMR")
MeOH_plasma_extraction_xlsx <- file.path(MeOH_plasma_extraction_dir, "dummy_metadata.xlsx")
exp_subj_id <- readxl::read_excel(MeOH_plasma_extraction_xlsx, sheet = 1)
subj_id_age <- readxl::read_excel(MeOH_plasma_extraction_xlsx, sheet = 2)

zip_files <- fs::dir_ls(MeOH_plasma_extraction_dir, glob = "*.zip")
dataset <- nmr_read_samples(sample_names = zip_files)

dataset <- nmr_meta_add(dataset, metadata = exp_subj_id, by = "NMRExperiment")
dataset <- nmr_meta_add(dataset, metadata = subj_id_age, by = "SubjectID")

dataset <- nmr_interpolate_1D(dataset, axis = c(min = -0.5, max = 10, by = 2.3E-4))

regions_to_exclude <- list(water = c(4.6, 5), methanol = c(3.33, 3.39))
dataset <- nmr_exclude_region(dataset, exclude = regions_to_exclude)

dataset = nmr_baseline_removal(dataset, lambda = 6, p = 0.01)

peak_table <- nmr_detect_peaks(dataset,
                               nDivRange_ppm = 0.1,
                               scales = seq(1, 16, 2),
                               baselineThresh = NULL, SNR.Th = 3)

nmr_exp_ref <- nmr_align_find_ref(dataset, peak_table)
dataset_align <- nmr_align(dataset, peak_table, nmr_exp_ref, maxShift_ppm = 0.0015, acceptLostPeak = FALSE)

dataset_norm <- nmr_normalize(dataset_align, method = "pqn")

peak_table_integration = nmr_integrate_peak_positions(
  samples = dataset_norm,
  peak_pos_ppm = peak_table$ppm,
  peak_width_ppm = 0.006)

peak_table_integration = get_integration_with_metadata(peak_table_integration)

pyroglutamic_acid <- list(pyroglutamic_acid1 = c(4.19, 4.195),
                          pyroglutamic_acid2 = c(4.18, 4.186),
                          pyroglutamic_acid3 = c(4.175, 4.18),
                          pyroglutamic_acid4 = c(4.165, 4.172))
regions_basel_corr_ds <- nmr_integrate_regions(dataset_norm, pyroglutamic_acid, fix_baseline = TRUE)
regions_basel_corr_matrix <- nmr_data(regions_basel_corr_ds)

ppm_to_assign <- c(4.060960203, 3.048970634,2.405935596,0.990616851,0.986520147, 1.044258467)
identification <- nmr_identify_regions_blood (ppm_to_assign)
